title: Costing (Go kit)
summary: Stock valuation by moving average or FIFO — the two methods PSAK 202 and Indonesian tax accept (no LIFO): receive, issue, and undo either one exactly, with a take's value and what stays always adding up to the sen (a position with nothing left is worth nothing), FIFO takes recorded per layer so a cancellation puts goods back where they came from, and unit conversion to the base unit. Pure functions over a position the caller loads and stores.
when_to_use: A module that moves stock and must know what it is worth: the stock ledger, production, a bill of materials.
when_not_to_use: Selling prices, margins, or landed-cost allocation — price lists and purchasing.
Specific identification per serial number — it comes with lots and serials in the stock module.
